title: Add sell bill/invoice generation and straw color code field

requirements.summary: Update AddStrawForm to include color code input field
acceptanceCriteria: Add straw form displays a text input field labeled 'Color Code' or 'Straw Color Code'
The color code input is submitted along with other straw details when creating a new straw
Form validation allows the color code field to be optional

file_operations.description: Add a colorCode input field to the form with label 'Straw Color Code'. Include the field in the form state and pass it to the addOrUpdateStraw backend function when submitting. Make the field optional with empty string as default value.

requirements.summary: Update EditStrawForm to allow editing straw color code
acceptanceCriteria: Edit straw form displays the current color code value in an editable text input
Updated color code is saved when the form is submitted
Color code field remains optional during editing

file_operations.description: Add a colorCode input field to the edit form that displays the existing straw.colorCode value. Include the field in the form state and pass it to the addOrUpdateStraw backend function when updating. Allow the field to remain empty if not provided.

requirements.summary: Display color code column in inventory table
acceptanceCriteria: InventoryTable component displays a 'Color Code' column
Each row shows the corresponding straw's color code value
Empty color codes display appropriately (e.g., '-' or empty cell)

file_operations.description: Add a 'Color Code' column to the table between the 'Storage Location' and 'Quantity' columns. Display straw.colorCode for each row, showing '-' when the value is empty or not provided.

requirements.summary: Add Generate Bill button in SalesHistory page for each sale record
acceptanceCriteria: Each sale row in the sales history table displays a 'Generate Bill' or 'View Invoice' button
Clicking the button displays a formatted bill/invoice with all sale details
Bill includes business header, sale information, buyer details, item details, and total price
User can print or download the bill as a PDF

file_operations.description: Add a 'Generate Bill' button/action to each sale row in the sales table. When clicked, fetch the sale bill data using the generateSaleBill backend function and display the BillView component in a dialog or modal. The button should be placed in a new Actions column.

requirements.summary: Create invoice/bill component with professional print layout
acceptanceCriteria: Bill component displays business name/logo at the top
Shows invoice number (sale ID), date, and buyer information
Displays itemized details: straw ID, bull ID, color code, quantity, unit price, and total
Includes a print button and is print-optimized with proper CSS
Layout uses the agricultural theme with appropriate styling

file_operations.description: Create a new component that accepts SaleBill data (containing sale, straw, and totalAmount). Display a professionally formatted invoice with: business header 'Semen Straw Business', invoice number (saleId), sale date, buyer name and contact, itemized straw details (strawId, bullId, colorCode, quality, quantitySold, salePrice), and calculated total amount. Include a print button that triggers window.print(). Use print-specific CSS (@media print) to optimize the layout for printing. Apply the agricultural theme colors from index.css for styling.

Add a new React Query hook useGenerateSaleBill that accepts a saleId parameter and calls the generateSaleBill backend function. Return the SaleBill data including sale details, straw details, and total amount. Handle loading and error states appropriately.
